correctness.rationale: Every operator is an automorphism because all negative-side weights and reciprocals are uniformly bounded; the positive-side product coordinates allow arbitrary nonzero finite weights. For each fixed starting basis coordinate, its evolved modulus is bounded above/below by constant multiples of P_n after cancellation of at most finitely many negative weights. The same comparison forces all nonzero vectors to have unbounded negative-coordinate norm precisely when sup P_n is infinite, yielding metric positive expansivity. Hypercyclicity iff liminf P_n=0 follows from the finite-support transitivity construction and its necessity from hypercyclic orbit approaches to zero. Mixing iff P_n→0 follows by that construction for all large n and by testing U near e0 and V near the norm-origin. Exact alternating block arithmetic gives limsup infinity and liminf zero. There are no unproved asymptotic estimates or computational extrapolations.
